concerns.text: The plan cites ClinicalTrials.gov and OSF as the sole data sources (see the ‘Dataset Strategy’ table). These registries often do not publish the detailed summary statistics (means, SDs) required for Hedges’ g calculation. Relying exclusively on them may leave the pipeline without sufficient numeric outcome data, jeopardizing the ability to compute effect sizes and answer the research question. Consider supplementing registry data with full-text articles (e.g., PubMed‑indexed publications) or a manual data‑extraction step to ensure the necessary statistics are available.
